### Prerequisite (listed separately)
card_ext_credit_balance_refund -> card_ext_first_late_fee_courtesy, form state. Sentence "The credit balance refund is fixed only after every late fee that is the only late fee of the last 12 months, with at least 1.00 of it still standing after the reversals already posted against it, on an account with no courtesy reversal in that time carries its courtesy reversal." appears verbatim only in credit_balance_refund_computation; grep over all of docs/ finds it nowhere else. Basis: courtesy_late_fee_reversal "The courtesy reversal posts against the late fee it reverses" and courtesy_reversal_amount_computation's qualifying test use the same words; records (b60b1fb0 only late fee, 28.07 standing, b6d7f501 is regulatory_cap) show the state unmet. Strength and connective match; the depended-on documents do not carry the sentence; condition / resolved_by appear nowhere.
